entry.title: Managers we are, but interrogators we must be

link.title: Managers we are, but interrogators we must be

entry.summary: I think we can all agree that our craft has changed a lot over the last year. For a while, AI was mostly a smarter autocomplete and a faster Stack Overflow. Then, somewhere around the end of last year, many of us simply stopped writing code by hand. Hence the popular line: we are not coders anymore, we are managers of agents. entry.title: C++26: std::constant_wrapper
entry.summary: There’s a fundamental gap in C++ that trips up everyone who reaches for it: you can’t pass a constexpr value through a function boundary and have it remain constexpr on the other side. The value is known at compile time, the function is constexpr, but the parameter inside the function body is not a constant expression.
